description.zh-CN: CloudTower 4.9.0 受控验收候选：物理盘 SMART 与每日历史、本地化和劣化风险；真实主机采集尚未验收。
description.en-US: CloudTower 4.9.0 controlled acceptance candidate: localized disk SMART, daily history and deterioration. Live host collection remains unverified.

compatibility.tower: CloudTower 4.9.0 controlled candidate; real SMART collection remains unverified.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 0.1.4 本地兼容候选：仅更新兼容声明为 schema 2，要求框架 [0.2.0, 0.3.0)、API 1 与 Tower 4.9.0，SMTX 不作全局准入条件。前端功能与 0.1.3 逐字节一致；不新增设备策略、审批或采集能力，真实采集和新组合实机验收仍未完成。
releaseNotes.en-US: 0.1.4 local compatibility candidate: schema 2 requires framework [0.2.0, 0.3.0), API 1 and Tower 4.9.0, without a global SMTX product gate. Frontend bytes match 0.1.3. No new device policy, approval or collection capability; real collection and live acceptance of this combination remain unverified.

purpose.zh-CN: 每日采集已配置磁盘的 SMART 数据
purpose.en-US: Collect SMART for configured disks daily
